latin: Demones et animae peccatrices patiuntur ab igne, in quantum calidus est, afflictione eiusdem rationis cum ea qua affliguntur corpora.
translation: Demons and sinful souls are afflicted by fire, insofar as it is hot, in the same way and to the same degree that bodies are afflicted by it.
translation_note: Comments on Peter Lombard's Sentences, on the metaphysical correspondence between physical and spiritual operations (Farmer's note, farmer1998:12530). Sense checked against farmer1998:12561.
